an10.63:1.1: yekeci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃgatā sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā
an10.63:1.2: pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhā
an10.63:1.4: sattakkhattuṃparamassa kolaṃkolassa ekabījissa sakadāgāmissa yo ca diṭṭheva dhamme arahā
an10.63:1.7: antarāparinibbāyissa upahaccaparinibbāyissa asaṃkhāraparinibbāyissa sasaṃkhāraparinibbāyissa uddhaṃsotassa akaniṭṭhagāmino
an10.63:1.9: yekeci bhikkhave mayi niṭṭhaṃgatā sabbe te diṭṭhisampannā
an10.63:1.10: tesaṃ diṭṭhisampannānaṃ imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha niṭṭhā imesaṃ pañcannaṃ idha vihāya niṭṭhāti.
